cost.scope: server finite run; record/source/role/transfer times are subsets of observed process total, not additive again. Local development/packaging/MCP/people cost excluded. No speed comparison or learning cost verdict.

role_coverage.scope: all 8-token bijections role stage (4 Hamming equivalence classes), fixed Program/Config/initial; not all full-pipeline executions

stage_transfer.scope: role(64)->expr(384) is exhaustive across all 4^3 Hamming-distance triples for all 40320 3-bit bijections; feasible1..4(60) and query1..4(680) are exhaustive Boolean corners at worst-case inner-margin [false_max, true_min] bounds across capacities n=1..4, not 64^n full product enumeration
